grammar.title: 本册宾语从句完整知识点
lines: 什么是宾语从句 § 用一个句子做为宾语来使用。 主语 + 及物动词 + 宾语从句(陈述句) 宾语从句的时态 § 宾语从句的种类（3类） 1、That + 引导词 (口语、不做成分时省略) + 肯定句 2、if + 一般疑问句 (陈述语序) 3、what/who... + 特殊疑问句 (陈述语序) 如何识别宾语从句 有时引导词是可以省略的(that)，我们在识别的时候主要还是看： 及物动词 + 句子 ，像这样的是： 主 + 谓 + 宾，但我们在前期课程中也学到过一个：主 + 谓 + 宾 + 宾，这样的主谓双宾结果就是： 及物 动词 + sb. +句子 ，也是宾语从句的一种。 宾语从句否定前移(表达观点：think, believe, feel...) 谓语动词是表示“看法、感觉、推测”的动词（如 feel, think, believe, suppose, imagine ...）时，如果想要否定后面的从句，习惯上会将否定词 not 搬到主句中。 I don't feel (that) + 肯定从句 特例：我知道你是不对的。≠ 我不知道你是对的。
I believe this house is for sale .
She said he would not let her make another film .
A. 主句一般现在，从句任意时态
B. 主句一般过去，从句相应过去
主语 谓语/系动词 引导词 从句
He says that he is ...
thinks feels ...
believes has (got) ...
knows needs ...
understands wants ...
is afraid can ...
is sorry must ...
is sure will ...
主语 谓语/系动词 引导词 从句 一般疑问句(简单句)
I want to know If/whether he is a doctor . Is he a doctor? 他是医生吗？
they were in Beijing . Were they in Beijing? 他们以前在北京吗？
he will go there. Will he go there? 他打算去吗？
you have watched the movie. Have you watched the movie?你看过这部电影吗？
you like red. Do you like red? 你喜欢红色吗？
he went to SH. Did he go to SH yesterday? 他昨天去上海了吗？
特殊疑问句(简单句) 宾语从句(引导词做成分不可省略)
Who is he? 他是谁？ I want to know who he is .
Where were you yesterday?你昨天在哪？ where you were yesterday.
When will he come back?他什么时候回来？ when he will come back.
What books have you read ?你读过什么书？ what books you have read.
Which car does he like?他喜欢哪辆车？ which car he likes .
What present do you like?你喜欢什么礼物？ what present you like .
宾语从句通常出现在主句中作为动词的宾语I don't know who she is.
宾语从句在语法上可以替代一个名词或名词短语作为整个句子的宾语 He said he would come tomorrow.
宾语从句通常由连词引导 She asked me if I had finished the work.
宾语从句的语序与陈述句的语序一样 I wonder where he went.
宾语从句有时可以根据语义和逻辑思考来判断 She believes that honesty is the best policy.
主 + 谓 引导词 从句
及物动词 + that(不做成分可省略) 句子(陈述句)
if
what
when
where
which
who
... 其它特殊疑问词
主 + 谓 宾语 引导词 从句
及物动词 + sb. + that 句子(陈述句语序)
if
what
when
where
which
who
... 其它特殊疑问词
Tell me what you did yesterday.
He asked when I would get married.
I think you are not right. × (否定了right,所以不能这样使用) I don't think(在主句里去否定think) you are right. ✓
我认为你是不对的。 我不认为你是对的。
I don't feel that he is the right person for the job. ⇒ I feel that he is not the right person... (虽然语法通，但不地道)
I don't feel as if I belong here. 我感觉我不属于这里（我在这里格格不入）
I don't feel I can trust him. 我觉得我不能相信他。
I don't feel I've accomplished very much today. 我觉得我今天一事无成~
I don't feel I'm such a dope. 我觉得我不是一个孤儿。
I don't think it's fine today. 我觉得今天天气不好 = 我不觉得今天天气好。
I don't think he is awesome/cool. 我觉得他不帅 = 我不觉得他帅
I know you are not right. 我知道你是不对的。 (强调不对)
I don't know you are right. 我不知道你是对的。(强调不知道)

sentences.title: 宾语从句练习
lines: 完成下面的练习 模仿改写以下句子 时态练习
第一者（问） 第二者(没听清) 第三者(转述)
Are you tired? What does he want to know? He wants to know if you are tired.
Why are you tired? He wants to know why you are tired.
Are you reading? He wants to know if you are reading.
What are you reading? He wants to know what you are reading.
Does Tom always do his homework? He wants to know if Tom always does his homework.
When does Tom do his homework? He wants to know when Tom does his homework.
一般疑问句 宾语从句 问原因(Why?)
Are you tired? I want to know if you are tired. Tell me if you are tired. I want to know why you are tired. Tell me why you are tired.
Are you late? I want to know if you are late. Tell me if you are late. I want to know why you are late. Tell me why you are late.
Are you dirty?
Are you lazy?
Are you busy?
Are you happy?
一般疑问句 宾语从句 在做什么(What?)
Are you reading? I want to know if you are reading. Tell me if you are reading. I want to know what you are reading. Tell me what you are reading.
Are you writing? I want to know if you are writing. Tell me if you are writing. I want to know what you are writing. Tell me what you are writing.
Are you painting?
Are you cooking?
Are you playing?
一般疑问句 宾语从句 什么时候(When?)
Did Tom go to bed early? I want to know if Tom went to bed early. Tell me if Tom went to bed early. I want to know when Tom went to bed. Tell me when Tom went to bed.
Did Tom get up early? I want to know if Tom got up early. Tell me if Tom got up early. I want to know when Tom got up . Tell me when Tom got up .
Did Tom arrive late?
Did Tom do his homework yesterday?
Did Tom have a bath yesterday?

expand.title: 宾语从句在口语中的使用
lines: 宾语从句强化练习
在 口语中 与书面一样的需要遵循从句为 陈述句 顺序。
I don’t know what you are talking about . 我不知道你在说什么。
Are you talking about . 你在说什么?
I forget what I had for breakfast this morning . 我忘记早饭吃了什么。
had I for breakfast this morning ? 我今早吃早餐吗？
I want to know what she is doing . 我想知道她在干嘛。
Is she doing ? 她正在做吗？
一般疑问句
Are you busy? I want to know if you are busy.
Is the shirt dirty? I want to know if the shirt is dirty.
Is Tom lazy? I want to know if Tom is lazy.
Is Mary sleeping? I want to know if Mary is sleeping.
Are you watching TV? I want to know if you are watching TV.
Is he climbing the tree? I want to know if he is climbing the tree.
Are you going to paint this bookcase? I want to know if you are going to paint this bookcase.
Is she going to have a holiday? I want to know if she is going to have a holiday.
Are they going to move into the new house? I want to know if they are going to move into the new house.
特殊疑问句
Where is the restroom? Can you tell me where the restroom is ?
Who is he? I want to know who he is .
When is your birthday? I want to know when your birthday is .
